headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Outcome of the Board Meeting held on 12 October 2026
summary: Q1 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹15,300 Cr (+10.5% YoY, +4.7% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹4,418 Cr (+2.7% YoY, margin 28.9%); PAT ₹2,895 Cr (+27.0% YoY, +6.7% QoQ).
raw_text: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on 12 October 2026

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results (PDF p. 10, reported in ₹ Million; normalised ÷10 to ₹ crore).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹1,52,998.8 Mn − Total Expenses ₹1,17,206.0 Mn = ₹35,792.8 Mn) + Finance Costs (₹996.7 Mn) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹7,387.2 Mn) = ₹44,176.7 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹4,417.67 Cr (28.87% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Exceptional Items and Tax = ₹40,988.1 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹4,098.81 Cr (before exceptional items of ₹3,234.4 Mn).
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period (after tax and exceptional items) = ₹28,947.9 Mn ÷ 10 = ₹2,894.79 Cr.

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ million (Page 10) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii
